# SRV Detailing — Full Reference

> SRV Detailing is a professional mobile car valeting and detailing business with over 22 years of experience. Based in Dukinfield, Greater Manchester, we serve customers throughout Manchester, Stockport, Warrington, Macclesfield, Congleton, Wilmslow, Alderley Edge, Knutsford, Tameside and all surrounding areas. Our fully mobile service means we come to you — at home, at work, or any other location. No need to drop your car off at a garage.

## What Makes SRV Detailing Different

SRV Detailing is a specialist, owner-operated mobile detailing business. Every job is carried out by the same experienced detailer — not outsourced to a franchise operative or junior employee. This ensures consistent quality on every vehicle.

We are fully mobile: our professional-grade equipment, lighting, polishers, extraction machines and chemicals travel with us in our purpose-built van. Customers simply need to provide a water source and electricity at their property (or we can work without both in certain circumstances).

We work on all vehicle types: hatchbacks, saloons, estates, SUVs, coupes, convertibles, prestige/luxury vehicles, vans and 4x4s.

## Full Service Menu With Pricing

### Car Valeting

**Mini Valet** — from £35
Quick refresh service ideal between full valets. Includes: exterior pressure wash and contact wash, wheel clean, interior vacuum, wipe-down of hard surfaces, glass clean inside and out.

**Exterior Valet** — from £35
Full exterior-only clean. Includes: snow foam pre-wash, two-bucket contact wash, wheel and arch clean, tyre dressing, wax or quick detailer protection.

**Interior Valet** — from £35
Full interior-only clean. Includes: thorough vacuum of all carpets and seats, wipe-down of all plastics and trims, glass clean, door shuts cleaned, fragrance applied.

**Full Valet** — from £65
Complete inside and out service combining Exterior Valet and Interior Valet. One of the most popular services for customers who want a thorough clean without committing to full detailing.

**Upholstery Cleaning** — from £60
Hot water extraction cleaning for fabric seats and carpets. Removes embedded dirt, stains and allergens. Leaves seats noticeably fresher and cleaner. Suitable for fabric interiors including cloth, alcantara and mixed materials.

**Pet Hair Removal** — from £40
Specialist removal of embedded pet hair from seats and carpets using professional rubber tools and extraction equipment. Particularly effective for high-density pet hair that standard vacuuming cannot remove.

**Odour Removal** — from £50
Elimination of unpleasant car smells including pet odour, cigarette smoke, food smells and damp/mould. We use professional-grade deodorising agents and ozone treatment where required, not just fragrance masking.

### Car Detailing

**Exterior Detail** — from £100
Deep-clean exterior service including: full decontamination (iron fallout remover, tar remover, clay bar), machine polishing for enhanced gloss, and application of a synthetic wax or paint sealant for protection.

**Interior Detail** — from £80
Professional-grade interior deep clean including: steam cleaning of all surfaces (seats, carpets, door cards, dashboard, vents), extraction cleaning, leather cleaning and conditioning (where applicable), glass polishing.

**Full Detail** — from £160
Combines full exterior and interior detailing into one comprehensive service. Leaves the vehicle in showroom condition.

**Paint Correction** — from £150
Multi-stage machine polishing process to remove paint defects including swirl marks, fine scratches, water spots, bird lime etching and oxidation. Significantly improves gloss, clarity and depth of colour. Results are permanent (unlike wax or sealant protection which only hides defects temporarily). Single-stage from £150, multi-stage from £250.

**Swirl Mark Removal** — from £120
Single-stage paint correction targeted specifically at removing the fine circular scratches (swirl marks) commonly caused by automated car washes and incorrect washing technique. Most effective on darker-coloured vehicles where swirl marks are most visible.

**Headlight Restoration** — from £45 per pair
Removes oxidation, yellowing, hazing and UV damage from polycarbonate headlight lenses. Restores optical clarity, improves night-time visibility and updates the look of the front end. Includes UV protective sealant to prevent rapid re-oxidation.

**Engine Bay Detailing** — from £60
Safe degreasing, cleaning and dressing of the engine bay. Removes built-up oil, grime and road fallout. Plastic and rubber components treated with a UV-resistant dressing. Improves appearance and can aid detection of future leaks.

**Leather Conditioning** — from £50
Specialist clean and deep conditioning treatment for leather seats and interior leather surfaces. Removes surface dirt and body oil, restores moisture balance, and applies a conditioner to prevent cracking and fading. Recommended every 6–12 months.

**New Car Protection** — from £250
Ceramic coating application for brand-new or nearly-new vehicles. Protects factory paint from day one, before road grime, bird droppings and UV exposure can cause damage. Includes a light decontamination wash, IPA wipe-down and ceramic coating application.

**Ceramic Coating** — from £300
Long-lasting nano-ceramic liquid polymer coating that chemically bonds to paintwork. Unlike waxes (3–6 week protection) or paint sealants (3–6 month protection), ceramic coatings last 2–7+ years with proper maintenance. Creates a hydrophobic, dirt-repelling surface with exceptional gloss depth.

Ceramic coating packages:
- Entry (3-year): £300–£400. Excellent hydrophobic properties, good chemical resistance.
- Mid-range (3–4 year): £500–£700. Enhanced chemical and UV resistance, deeper gloss.
- Premium (5–7+ year): £800–£1,200+. Maximum protection, hardest coating, showroom-level finish.

All ceramic coating packages include: full decontamination wash, paint correction, IPA panel wipe and coating application. Aftercare products and guidance included.

## Products Used

SRV Detailing uses professional-grade products from industry-leading brands:

- **Gtechniq** — ceramic coatings, panel wipes, glass coatings, wheel sealants
- **Koch-Chemie** — iron fallout removers, degreasers, shampoos, paint sealants
- **Meguiar's** — polishes, waxes, interior products
- **Angelwax** — specialist detailing products
- **CarPro** — ceramic coating boosters and maintenance products

All products are trade-grade, not available in consumer retail outlets.
